problems:
# Saint Kitts and Nevis — problems

- Split published: Island of St. Kitts (Police Districts A & B) vs Island of Nevis (Police District C), plus Federation total. No split between districts A and B was found.
- Sources: RSCNPF comparative statistics PDFs (sknis.gov.kn 2021–2023 Jan–Dec; police.kn 2022 Jan–Dec; police.kn 2021–2023 July–September). Extracted with pdftotext and a script. Measures: "MURDER / MANSLAUGHTER" (2022 report: "HOMICIDES (Murder/Manslaughter)") and "ATTEMPTED MURDER"; breakdowns Total / Detected / Juvenile as published.
- July–September rows are one quarter only (note says so); do not read them as annual.
- police.kn/statistics (index page listing more reports, e.g. 2024–2025) returned HTTP 403 to direct downloads; the web reader needs a search-result URL and none was returned for the index. Later years not obtained.
- Percent/detection-rate tables in the PDFs were not extracted (derived values).
